name: Missing-Evidence Abstention
mechanism: Applies an explicit evidence-sufficiency contract and returns bounded uncertainty or an approved escalation instead of unsupported completion.
use_when: Answers require external provenance or high-stakes grounding
Negative and unanswerable questions occur in production
avoid_when: The task explicitly permits unsourced general knowledge
No labeled negative cases exist to calibrate the threshold
expected_effects: Fewer unsupported claims on missing evidence
failure_modes: False sufficiency accepts merely related text
Hidden fallback to model memory violates the contract
